sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's tech sector is increasingly decoupled from US tech, driven by domestic digital adoption and government digitalization push, creating a structural premium for local-listed tech names.

Local currency stability and falling IDR rates are lowering the discount rate for high-growth Indonesian tech, making the sector's earnings yield more attractive versus regional peers.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian tech leverage now: the +1.85% ID outperformance vs US +0.61% confirms local beta is accelerating on global AI/semiconductor momentum (SK Hynix +30%, Samsung +27%). Rotate into liquid IDX tech names and IRSX/PMUI proxies; expect continued catch-up as US mega-cap strength spills over. Trim only if IDX tech breaks below its 20-day moving average.
